top_signals.title: Qatar and Iran discuss temporary Strait of Hormuz corridor plan
top_signals.summary: Qatar and Iran held talks on a proposed phased framework that includes creating a temporary joint shipping corridor with Oman through the Strait of Hormuz, according to Qatar’s foreign ministry.
